rulings.docket_item: Cluster-adoption proposal (from peer_c15.json's P07-034 ruling): the byte-verified lev/adam chiastic inclusio bracketing Prov.16.1 and Prov.16.9, corroborated by the writer's own disclosures at the bracket rows P07-030/P07-038 -- decide whether Prov.16.1-Prov.16.9 is adopted as a proverb_cluster respan across the nine single_proverb rows P07-030 through P07-038, handled as a parent-grouping/relations disclosure without respanning, or left at the peer's rival-engagement cure only; the strategy's documented 15:33-16:9 candidate and the YHWH-token density texture weighed under the atomic default's burden on adoption.
rulings.decision: DECLINE adoption of any respan -- the nine single_proverb rows P07-030 through P07-038 stand at their spans; the strategy's 15:33-16:9 candidate is closed against adoption at this mesh; no new parent-grouping object is created. The lev/adam inclusio is affirmed byte-genuine as a two-verse FRAME correspondence and remains a disclosure-level object: peer_c15's P07-034 cure is ratified unchanged, and its rival-engagement class is completed symmetrically at the bracket rows P07-030/P07-038 with digit-bearing interior-incoherence grounds.
rulings.grounds: Re-derived at every named tier under the B-2 carriage standard, applied here to a multi-row grouping where the atomic default's burden is heavier than at r1's 2-verse merges. (1) FRAME VERIFIED (tier-1, skeleton and byte): oshb:Prov.16.1 opens לְאָדָ֥ם מַֽעַרְכֵי לֵ֑ב (adam-form word 1, lev word 3) and oshb:Prov.16.9 opens לֵ֣ב אָ֭דָם (lev word 1, adam word 2) -- the same two content lexemes in inverted order, a genuine chiastic inclusio; both B-cola then open on a divine-name form (וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה at 16:1, וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה at 16:9) predicating divine determination against human planning (“The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.” (web:Prov.16.1); “A man's heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.” (web:Prov.16.9)) -- a third frame correspondence. Honest object note per allography discipline: 16:1's adam is lamed-prefixed לאדם while 16:9's is bare אדם; the contiguous skeleton bigram לב אדם = 1 verse book-wide (Prov.16.9 only; sweep.py --skel, verse-count unit). The frame is real and designed-looking. (2) BUT THE FRAME BINDS ONLY THE TWO BRACKETS, NOT THE NINE MEMBERS. Word-bound shared-token audit over all eight interior seams (skeleton tier, word-bound token intersection, re-derived): 16:1|16:2 = 0 shared tokens (16:1 carries the divine name only as prefixed ומיהוה, never bare); 16:2|16:3, 16:3|16:4, 16:5|16:6, 16:6|16:7 share only יהוה; 16:4|16:5 shares יהוה plus the ambient particle כל; 16:7|16:8 = 0; 16:8|16:9 = 0. Controlling-object note (method step 3): peer_c15 reported the 16:1|16:2 intersection as the bare divine name at lexeme grain (counting the prefixed form); this ruling's controlling object for the incoherence digits is the word-bound skeleton token, digit pair 0 (word-bound) vs 1 (lexeme-grain) -- both derivations support interior incoherence and do not conflict. (3) Prov.16.8 (טוב מעט בצדקה מרב תבואות בלא משפט, skeleton) carries no divine-name form at all and shares ZERO word-bound tokens with BOTH neighbors -- the eighth member of the proposed unit is byte-linked to nothing on either side. (4) The lev/adam pairing is not itself distributionally marked at co-occurrence level: a lev-form and an adam-form co-occur in about 10 verses book-wide (12:23, 15:11, 16:1, 16:9, 17:18, 19:3, 24:12, 24:30, 27:19, 28:14 -- token audit; a naive substring scan adds a false boker-class hit at 20:25 per the hazard catalog); what is unique is the 16:9 bigram (digit 1) and the chiastic verse-edge placement -- a frame signal, not member glue. (5) YHWH density is texture, never a driver (owner addendum; the docket so stipulates), and its digits are object-dependent: word-bound bare יהוה = 9 verses in ch 15 and 6 in ch 16 (the strategy's figures), while any-prefixed divine-name verse counts are 9 and 11 -- either way tier-2/3 distributional texture with 16:8 inside the span carrying none. (6) The strategy's documented 15:33-16:9 CANDIDATE fails at its own left edge: Prov.15.33 opens יראת יהוה מוסר חכמה (skeleton) -- no lev, no adam; the byte-grounded bracket sits at 16:1/16:9, not 15:33; and 15:33 is the closing member of the mesh-ratified proverb_cluster P07-029 (Prov.15.31-Prov.15.33, its tokhachat/musar catchword chain byte-verified in peer_c15's supported sample), so adopting the candidate would break a ratified grouping on texture-tier evidence. CARRIAGE CONCLUSION: under B-2's standard the envelope evidence is maximal BETWEEN the brackets and absent WITHIN the span -- a 9-verse proverb_cluster would rest on a frame whose seven interior members share at most the bare divine name with anything, two of its seams sharing nothing at all. The evidence permits (and the corpus already performs) a disclosure-level record of the inclusio; it does not carry a unit. The middle path of a NEW parent-grouping object is likewise declined without owner referral: the closed 8-value unit_type vocabulary offers no envelope-with-atomic-members type, and none is needed -- verse-anchored cross-row disclosure at the bracket rows (already present in P07-030/P07-038 device_notes and observed_substrate_signals) IS the relations record under existing law; creating a new grouping layer would be legislating, which this docket item does not require.

consequence.spec: No respan, no unit_type change, no confidence change: P07-030 through P07-038 stand as nine single_proverb rows tiling Prov.16.1-Prov.16.9 (tiling re-verified from the combined corpus); the 15:33-16:9 candidate is closed against adoption at this mesh. Author wave, disclosure work in THREE rows: (a) P07-034: peer_c15's work order is RATIFIED UNCHANGED -- the rejected_alternative's engaged rival becomes the 16:1-16:9 envelope-unit reading grounded in the lev/adam chiastic inclusio, rejected because the interior verses share no uniform construction or content token with either bracket beyond the bare divine name; the gap-free-YHWH-run point survives at most as the optional second sentence. (b) SYMMETRY COMPLETION of the same systemic class (a sweep, not a spot fix) at the bracket rows: P07-030's rejected_alternative currently rebuts the nine-verse rival ONLY on the 16:8 divine-name gap -- a ground responsive to the dead-on-arrival YHWH-run framing, not to the inclusio framing -- and P07-030/P07-038 device_notes carry the digit-less negative claim that the interior verses 'do not uniformly share the construction' / intervene 'without uniform support.' ONE edit per bracket row: re-ground the envelope-rival rejection in the digit-bearing interior-incoherence audit (word-bound shared tokens per interior seam at most the bare divine name יהוה; 16:1|16:2, 16:7|16:8, and 16:8|16:9 share zero word-bound tokens; טוב מעט בצדקה מרב תבואות בלא משפט carries no divine-name form), keeping the 16:8 YHWH-gap observation as secondary texture; and add the honest object note to the inclusio disclosure -- 16:1 lamed-prefixed לאדם vs 16:9 bare אדם, contiguous bigram לב אדם = 1 verse book-wide (16:9 only). (c) The interior rows' class-level Hebrew-engagement sweep (peer_c15's P07-031 remedy) is untouched by this ruling. Cure tests (each the test that killed what it replaces): the revised P07-030/P07-034/P07-038 sentences must name the inclusio, not the YHWH run, as the rebutted rival; re-run the word-bound shared-token audit over all eight interior seams and confirm the stated digits exactly; sweep.py --skel לב אדם = 1 with Prov.16.9 the sole ref; check_universals.py (no digit-less negative universal remains in the three rows), citation_sweep.py, and check_refs_mirror.py GREEN on the three revised rows; every quoted Hebrew run byte-collated via collate.py.

rulings.docket_item: Corrected-warrant survival (from peer_c13.json's P06-075 ruling, rows spanning Prov.14.26-Prov.14.27): the cluster's original warrant -- the same two-word construct opening both verses in the same grammatical role -- is byte-false (bet-prefixed adverbial at 14:26 vs bare subject at 14:27), while the phrase-level fact stands (the fear-of-YHWH phrase's only consecutive-verse pair among 15 contiguous-substring hits book-wide). Decide whether the proverb_cluster survives on a corrected warrant passing the prefix-variation and role-split tests that killed the original, or is demoted to two single_proverb rows with seam-pair disclosure; state the author work order either way.
rulings.decision: The cluster does NOT survive -- no corrected warrant exists in the bytes that passes the prefix-variation and role-split tests that killed the original. ADOPT the demotion: P06-075 is replaced by two single_proverb rows, Prov.14.26-Prov.14.26 and Prov.14.27-Prov.14.27, carrying one symmetric seam-pair disclosure. peer_c13's escalate-eligible question is answered by the existing B-2 carriage standard, so no owner_escalation is needed.
rulings.grounds: Re-derived independently from consonantal_index.json and the pointed bytes; peer_c13's decomposition confirmed EXACTLY, then extended. (1) THE ORIGINAL WARRANT IS DEAD (tier-1): Prov.14.26 opens בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה (byte-spliced; skeleton token ביראת, bet-prefixed) as a prepositional/adverbial modifier whose clause subject is the following מִבְטַח עֹ֑ז -- “In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress” (web:Prov.14.26) -- while Prov.14.27 opens יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה (skeleton token יראת, bare) as itself the clause subject of מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים -- “The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life” (web:Prov.14.27). Two different word-bound tokens in two different grammatical roles: the prefix-variation and role-split findings stand. (2) THE PHRASE-LEVEL FACT ALSO STANDS, WITH ITS OBJECT NAMED: contiguous skeleton substring יראת יהוה = 15 verses book-wide (sweep.py --skel re-run: Prov.1.7, 1.29, 2.5, 8.13, 9.10, 10.27, 14.26, 14.27, 15.16, 15.33, 16.6, 19.23, 22.4, 23.17, 31.30), whose SOLE adjacent pair is 14:26|14:27. Decomposed by word-bound host: bare יראת = 10 verses (1:7, 2:5, 8:13, 9:10, 10:27, 14:27, 15:33, 19:23, 22:4, 31:30); prefixed hosts = 5 verses (ויראת 1:29, ביראת 14:26, 15:16, וביראת 16:6, 23:17). NEITHER word-bound object contains a single adjacent pair anywhere in the book (adjacency computed over both sorted lists) -- the seam is consecutive ONLY at the blended substring tier, across the two sub-objects. Per the B-3 precedent the word-bound token is the citation-grade object for shared wording; the 15-digit survives only as an honestly-decomposed substring-tier phrase disclosure. (3) CORRECTED-WARRANT SEARCH under the B-2 carriage standard -- every limb-(ii) arm fails: (a) verbatim multi-word repeat: absent at word-bound tier (ביראת != יראת; contrast B-1's abomination formula, skeleton-identical in both its verses); (b) shared slot or clause template: any 'fear-phrase plus construct-noun-phrase verbless colon' template glosses over exactly the role split that killed the original -- adverbial-plus-following-subject at 14:26 vs subject-plus-predicate at 14:27 -- and so fails that test by construction; (c) tier-1 connective: none; the verses' word-bound shared-token set is the bare divine name alone. (4) POSITIVE COUNTEREVIDENCE (the B-4 pattern): 14:27's entire post-phrase text מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת is BYTE-IDENTICAL, cantillation included, to Prov.13.14's text after its subject תּוֹרַ֣ת חָ֭כָם (byte-spliced equality check; contiguous skeleton string מקור חיים לסור ממקשי מות = 2 verses book-wide, 13:14 and 14:27 only; מקור חיים = 4 verses: 10:11, 13:14, 14:27, 16:22). 14:27's strongest verbatim multi-word tie thus runs NON-adjacently: its benefit-predicate is interchangeable book-formula stock into which different subjects are slotted, not pair-designed binding with 14:26. (5) CONCLUSION: limb (i) holds only at the substring tier and merely PERMITS; limb (ii) fails on every arm; the refutation (stock formula predicate, no word-bound adjacency in any named object) survives the sweep. peer_c13's finding that no word-bound adjacent match exists to substitute is confirmed, and its escalate-eligible question -- whether a lighter-weight adjacent root-echo in divergent constructions suffices -- is ANSWERED BY EXISTING LAW, not by owner reinterpretation: under the B-2 carriage standard a repetition without structural binding obliges disclosure and never carries a merger. The atomic default holds; the cluster is demoted.

SEAM-PAIR DISCLOSURE = ONE edit installed symmetrically on both rows: (a) name the phrase echo with objects and digits -- contiguous skeleton substring יראת יהוה = 15 verses book-wide, sole consecutive pair at this seam, decomposed as bare word-bound יראת = 10 verses and prefixed hosts = 5 verses (ויראת / ביראת / וביראת classes), with NO adjacent pair inside either word-bound object -- never citing the blended 15 as a shared-wording count; (b) state the role split byte-grounded: בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה bet-prefixed adverbial with following subject מִבְטַח עֹ֑ז at 14:26 vs יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה bare subject with predicate מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים at 14:27; (c) refute pair-design via the stock-formula tie: מקור חיים לסור ממקשי מות (skeleton) = 2 verses book-wide (13:14, 14:27), byte-identical tails, and מקור חיים = 4 verses -- 14:27's predicate half is book formula, not seam glue. Each row keeps its own synthetic-parallelism device_notes. The driver swap re-opens the dependent fields per the standing rule: rejected_alternative (each row now rejects the cluster reading on the decomposition and role-split grounds), observed_substrate_signals, unit_type, confidence (author re-sets on the corrected evidence). boundary_evidence_refs: web:Prov.14.25 and web:Prov.14.28 (outer neighbors), oshb refs for the member verses, plus oshb:Prov.13.14 wherever the 13:14 tie is argued (check_refs_mirror discipline). Cure tests (each the test that killed what it replaces): (1) PREFIX-VARIATION -- no field asserts an identical/same/verbatim phrase across the seam, and any 15-verse digit appears only tier-labeled substring with the 10+5 decomposition adjacent; (2) ROLE-SPLIT -- every construction claim states the divergent grammatical roles; (3) sweep re-runs confirm the digit set exactly (15 / 10 / 5; sole consecutive pair at substring tier only; מקור חיים = 4; מקור חיים לסור ממקשי מות = 2); (4) check_tiling.py over Prov.14.1-Prov.14.35 reports 0 gaps/overlaps with the two rows installed; (5) citation_sweep.py, check_refs_mirror.py, check_universals.py, check_marks.py GREEN on both new rows; (6) every Hebrew run byte-collated via collate.py or explicitly tier-labeled.
